name: Jeremy Johnson
source: Ian has known Jeremy for a very long time. They used to be friends when they were kids and even took karate lessons together after school for a few years. Their paths diverged after high school until they met each other again at the local gym. Jeremy has changed quite a lot after all these years. He's a confident and easy-going guy who loves to go out, party, and flirt with the ladies.
